{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Sickly Tremor''''' was a [[Transport/Legends|slave caravel]] which [[Zephyrus]] had equipment outfitters on [[Ovise III]] modify with [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] cages strong enough to hold twelve [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] each. Zephyrus claimed these cages were to hold remarkably strong [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. The caravel never returned from its slave run, and one theory held it crashed on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], its slave passengers becoming ancestors of the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Phlog/Legends|Phlog]] and [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]] populations.
